method.method_draft: First expand the image into a heavy-atom graph. Count heavy-atom neighbor incidences: the four left-diene carbons have neighbor counts 2, 2, 3, and 2, totaling 9. The two right-alkene carbons have counts 1 and 2, totaling 3. The OMe group contributes O=2 and methyl C=1, totaling 3. The Me3SiO group contributes O=2, Si=4, and three methyl carbons with one neighbor each, totaling 9. The AcO group contributes bridging O=2, carbonyl C=3, carbonyl O=1, and acetyl methyl C=1, totaling 7. The CO2Et group contributes carbonyl C=3, carbonyl O=1, ethoxy O=2, ethyl CH2=2, and terminal CH3=1, totaling 9. The total incidence count is 9 + 3 + 3 + 9 + 7 + 9 = 40, and each bond is counted at both endpoints, so 40 / 2 = 20 bonds.
